contracts.docstring: Owner-observed exact author candidate; the host chooses the separate reviewer and readonly capabilities.
Admit one independent review through the existing owner/CSRF boundary and original receipt; never accept or publish.
Expose scoped owner history and only the configured adapter's actual task capabilities without opening inference.
Validate owner configuration and compose the actual serving controller.
Copy a bounded JSON check list into immutable validated recipes; reject unknown fields and environments without fallback.
Bind the exact host plan into the original frozen developer instructions without representing commands as successful tests.
Build subscription-only sessions with required Ken and host-owned private development views.
Reject invalid search configuration before admitting a product attempt.
Admit one original project attempt with required Ken and revocable peers.
Own native attempts and grant-bound tool closure before durable terminal states.
Admit one owner request with an optional observed independent review target.
Advertise only the configured adapter's supported authoring types; older adapters retain research-only admission.
Admit and schedule one owner-observed independent native code review without enabling authoring, acceptance or publication.
Schedule an admitted run once after checking its binding and execution profile.
Persist a safe, actionable owner explanation for this original run.
Own one admitted native turn, then prove peer/tool closure before finalizing it.
Public requests share the original owned coordinator; duplicate admission never edits, checks or reviews twice.
Bad host recipes cannot enable authoring with guessed executables, ignored fields or an unbounded check list.
Copy mutable configuration into immutable recipes and disclose every command in frozen host instructions.
The public service rejects unsupported authoring before persistence or tool authority instead of falling back to research.
A completed native turn cannot conceal missing capture/check closure or mark the public development task done.
Inject a host pipeline failure after the actual native turn, preserving real finalization and physical closure.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery have English docstrings. New frontend modules, exported helpers and components also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
